DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL).

The combination of lymphocytosis with "smudge cells" on the peripheral smear and a positive Direct Antiglobulin Test is pathognomonic for CLL, likely with autoimmune hemolytic anemia as a complication.
